signal: Ytel merged with SharpenCX in December 2025 after TELEO Capital acquired it, combining UCaaS, CCaaS, and CPaaS with new AI, analytics, and agent tooling.

email.body1:
George, saw Ytel merged with SharpenCX late last year, bringing AI, analytics, and agent tooling alongside the UCaaS, CCaaS, and CPaaS stack.

A merger like that usually means more accounts in play across both books than reps can work before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Ytel off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
George, quick follow-up for Ytel.

Post-merger, expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the combined number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Ytel needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
George, last bit of proof for Ytel.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other communications software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
George, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you integrate the SharpenCX merger, no problem at all. Merger integration is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a communications software motion? I will tailor it to Ytel either way.
